scripts.build: npm run assets:icons && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && ng-packagr -p projects/machetico-ui/ng-package.json -c projects/machetico-ui/tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.format: prettier --write projects scripts tests e2e demo *.mjs *.json README.md AGENTS.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs .github
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run docs:catalog && npm run demo:styles && node scripts/serve-demo.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check projects scripts tests e2e demo *.mjs *.json README.md AGENTS.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs .github
scripts.verify: npm run architecture:check && npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run ssr:test
scripts.release:check: npm run format:check && npm run verify && npm run test:e2e && npm audit && npm run pack && npm run package:check && npm run consumer:check && npm run publish:dry-run
